Playlist.title: Playlist
Playlist.description: Legacy schema; the current app does not use this collection. Custom audiophile playlist synced across devices and custom music API sources.

title.description: Display title of the playlist (1..80 chars).

accentHex.description: Hex color accent for dynamic expressive theming (e.g. #00F5D4).

sourceService.description: Primary custom music API source or hybrid provider.

isOfflinePinned.description: Legacy metadata flag only; it does not prove that audio files were downloaded.

trackIds.description: Ordered list of track IDs (max 100 tracks).

CustomMusicSource.title: CustomMusicSource
CustomMusicSource.description: Legacy schema; the current app does not use this collection. User-defined custom or open music API endpoint supporting all countries and regions.

name.description: Display name of the custom music API source (1..80 chars).

searchPath.description: Relative search path or query template (0..200 chars).

protocolType.description: Adapter protocol used to parse tracks and streams.

regionCode.description: Country/Area code for global routing (e.g. GLOBAL, US, JP, KR, DE, GB, TW, SG, BR, IN, FR, AU).

customHeaderName.description: Optional HTTP header name for custom authentication or routing (0..80 chars).

customHeaderValue.description: Optional HTTP header value or token (0..240 chars).

preferredCodec.description: Preferred audio codec label (1..40 chars, e.g. FLAC Hi-Res).

isEnabled.description: Whether this custom API source is active for global search and streaming.

SoundProfile.title: SoundProfile
SoundProfile.description: Legacy schema; the current app does not use this collection. Personalized 10-band parametric equalizer and audiophile DSP profile.

bandsDb.description: 10 integer values representing gain in tenths of dB (-120 to +120).

preampGainTenths.description: Pre-amplifier gain in tenths of dB (-120 to +120).

dacBitPerfectMode.description: Legacy metadata flag only; the current app does not claim or perform bit-perfect output.

isActive.description: Whether this profile is currently active.

SyncState.title: SyncState
SyncState.description: Legacy schema; the current app does not use this collection. Cross-platform playback handoff and active custom music API status.

deviceName.description: Name of the synced playback device (1..80 chars).

isPlaying.description: Whether playback is active on this session.

audioQualityBadge.description: Current codec/sample-rate badge (1..60 chars, e.g. 24-bit/192kHz FLAC).

activeSourceName.description: Name of the active custom music API source (1..80 chars).

LibraryBackup.title: LibraryBackup
LibraryBackup.description: Explicit user-owned snapshot at users/{uid}/backups/library. Contains playlists and online audio metadata, not local files or document grants.

/users/{userId}/playlists/{playlistId}.description: Legacy collection; not used by the current app. User custom playlists synced across devices and custom music APIs.

/users/{userId}/customSources/{sourceId}.description: Legacy collection; not used by the current app. User-defined custom music APIs with multi-country/region support.

/users/{userId}/soundProfiles/{profileId.description: Legacy collection; not used by the current app. User personalized 10-band equalizer and audiophile DSP presets.

/users/{userId}/syncState/{deviceId}.description: Legacy collection; not used by the current app. Cross-platform playback state and active custom music API info.

/users/{userId}/backups/library.description: Current app: one explicit user-owned backup of playlists and online links.

description: Legacy collection schemas remain for compatibility and are not used by the current app. The current app uses the LibraryBackup document.
